step.text: Start the shell command `sleep 12 && echo bg-finished` as a background task; do not wait for it. Reply with the single word started and end your turn. Later, when you are told that background command finished, run the shell command `sleep 20 && echo after-wake` in the foreground, wait for it, and reply with the single word woken.
